review_candidates.title: Forward Deployed Engineer Secure Services Edge (Remote)
review_candidates.description_excerpt: Cisco SSE deployment flexibility allows customers to select solutions tailored to their needs and transition seamlessly as requirements evolve. Represent the customer within the product organization by bringing production context, business impact, operational constraints, and technical requirements into build and prioritization discussions. Translate requirements, RCAs, and technical decisions between customer and engineering contexts without losing fidelity on either side. Key Responsibilities
eligibility_evidence: Experience supporting large multinational enterprise accounts with global SSE or SASE rollouts.
